input.title: Machine Learning Intern - Perception
input.descriptionText:
Bluefin Robotics makes autonomous inspection robots for underwater infrastructure. Our perception team is looking for a Machine Learning Intern for Summer 2026.

Responsibilities:
* Train and evaluate deep learning models for object detection on sonar and camera data
* Build data loading and augmentation pipelines
* Run experiments and present results to the team weekly

Minimum qualifications:
* Strong Python programming skills
* Hands-on experience with PyTorch
* Solid foundation in linear algebra and probability/statistics

Preferred qualifications:
* Coursework or projects in computer vision
* Experience with ROS
* C++ experience

We move fast and expect interns to take initiative. Curiosity and scientific rigor matter more to us than any specific background.

gold.summary: Perception ML internship training PyTorch object-detection models on sonar and camera data.
